title: Project skills & tools — two things the code turned up

steps.path: New conversation in a folder that isn't one of your projects
steps.headline: A conversation started outside any project: keep every skill and tool on, as today, or turn all of them off?
steps.today: A conversation in a folder that isn't one of your projects gets every installed skill and tool, including Chat Search. YouCoded has no private (incognito) conversation mode yet.
steps.problem: Two of your earlier answers disagree here. One says conversations outside a project get no automatic skills at all. Another says nothing that works today may quietly switch off.
steps.proposal: Outside a project, keep today's behaviour: everything on. When a private conversation mode is built, it gets nothing automatic, as you asked.

options.label: Keep today's behaviour
pros: Nothing you rely on stops working after the update
Your 'nothing automatic' rule still applies once private conversations exist
cons: Until then, conversations outside a project can't be limited

options.label: Nothing automatic outside
pros: Matches your earlier 'no automatic skills' answer exactly
cons: After the update, Chat Search and other skills stop being automatic in any folder that isn't a project, which may look like something broke

steps.headline: The Android app has no Projects screen yet. Leave phones for later in this build?
steps.today: In the Android app, the Projects screen shows nothing yet; it's a computer-only screen for now. If you open YouCoded on your phone through remote access to your computer, you get the full Projects screen, including Skills & tools.
steps.problem: Your last answer asked for the Skills & tools tab on Android with a note. My question assumed the phone app already has a Projects screen. It doesn't, so there's nowhere to put the tab.
steps.proposal: This build works on your computer and through remote access from your phone, and the switches there really do apply. The phone-app note ships whenever Projects comes to the Android app.

options.label: Phones later
pros: Remote access from your phone already gets the full tab
cons: The Android app itself shows nothing about project skills yet

options.label: Build Android Projects now
pros: The phone app gets a Projects screen too
cons: A whole separate feature; delays this one substantially
